subject.title: fix(reef): repeated relay reconnects no longer leave stale sockets active

question: Should Reef reconnect wait for close completion and forcibly terminate an unresponsive WebSocket after five seconds before starting the replacement generation?
rationale: This is a channel lifecycle and availability-policy choice: the patch intentionally trades delayed reconnect for preventing overlapping generations, and the supplied evidence does not show a prior owner decision establishing the five-second bound.

options.title: Confirm bounded teardown
options.body: Confirm that close-before-reconnect plus a five-second forced termination is the intended Reef transport contract, then refresh validation on the current merge result.

options.title: Use a different teardown policy
options.body: Choose a different timeout or reconnect policy if Reef service behavior requires longer graceful shutdowns or a different availability tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Confirm bounded teardown
recommendation.body: Confirm that close-before-reconnect plus a five-second forced termination is the intended Reef transport contract, then refresh validation on the current merge result.
